summary: Fixed 9 bugs: the Growth loop page crash on full timestamps, open feedback notes vanishing after 2 days, the verdict date one day early, watchdog closing still-failing workflow notices, Analytics skipping a Short's first Pacific day, and trend Shorts losing their queue place; plus a failing prompt-path test.
why: Main had one red test (writer.md named a missing file); the dashboard-ui and workers reviews found 9 bugs with concrete failing cases, each fixed with a test (the watchdog Shorts count excepted). The data audit was 24 h old (today's run not started yet), so the YouTube comparison was skipped.

findings.title: Data audit late, not failed
findings.detail: metrics/data-audit.json from 11 Nov 16:21 UTC; GitHub starts the 13:53 IST cron at 16:19-18:55 UTC, after this run began.

findings.title: One bad setting row resets all settings (protected file)
findings.detail: workers/lib/settings.ts falls back to every default when any row fails validation; owner notified with the fix.

findings.title: 9 Nov evening Shorts five minutes apart
findings.detail: 20:53 and 20:58 IST, outside the slots, on the day GitHub dropped Publish runs; the heartbeat added 12 Nov addresses it.

changes.title: Growth loop and Feedback page fixes
changes.detail: fmtDayKey reads timestamps; every open note shows; due date, start label and no-data confidence corrected; reference Shorts use live views.

changes.title: Workers fixes
changes.detail: Watchdog reads each workflow's latest run and counts only queued Shorts for Short slots; Analytics starts on the Pacific publish day; trend Shorts keep their place after the editor ranking.

changes.title: Prompt path test green
changes.detail: writer.md names remotion/public/real/<name>-head.png instead of a file that doesn't exist.

changes.title: Analysis for 9 Nov Shorts
changes.detail: Verdicts for v-20261109-01 (miss) and v-20261109-03 (okay); Magic Johnson entry updated with its drop points.
